triplets.head: Pre-myopia
triplets.tail: SER ≤ +0.75 D and > −0.50 D in children with risk factors

triplets.head: Pathological myopia

triplets.head: Undercorrection
triplets.tail: Does NOT slow and may ACCELERATE progression — contraindicated

triplets.head: Atropine
triplets.tail: Acts on retinal/scleral muscarinic receptors, dopamine modulation, NO signaling, scleral ECM remodeling inhibition — NOT primarily cycloplegia

triplets.head: Atropine
triplets.tail: 1 drop/eye at bedtime, continued 2–3 years, gradual tapering

triplets.head: Topical caffeine (2%)
triplets.tail: Did NOT slow progression as monotherapy

triplets.head: Lutein
triplets.tail: Improved macular pigment density in high myopes but no visual acuity improvement (Yoshida 2023 RCT)

triplets.head: Outdoor time
triplets.tail: Strong for onset prevention; weaker for slowing progression in existing myopes

triplets.head: Colored light therapy (RLRL)
triplets.tail: Photobiomodulation via cytochrome c oxidase → ATP, choroidal blood flow, dopamine/NO

triplets.head: Colored light therapy (RLRL)
triplets.tail: Observed — 0.42 mm vs 0.28 mm in 2-yr follow-up

triplets.head: UV-A therapy
triplets.tail: No significant effect in two trials

triplets.head: Refractive correction surgery
triplets.tail: Does NOT reduce lifetime risks of retinal detachment, maculopathy, or glaucoma

triplets.head: ICL (Visian)
triplets.tail: IOP elevation, cataract, endothelial cell loss

triplets.head: PRK
triplets.tail: Completely removed (mechanical debridement, brush, or dilute alcohol); discarded; regenerates under BCL

triplets.head: PRK
triplets.tail: Most discomfort of surface procedures (3–5 days)

triplets.head: LASEK
triplets.tail: Dilute alcohol (18–20%) applied 20–40 sec; epithelium peeled aside as thin flap; repositioned after ablation

triplets.head: LASEK
triplets.tail: Alcohol may cause transient limbal stem cell toxicity

triplets.head: Epi-LASIK
triplets.tail: Mechanical epithelial separator (epi-keratome) creates epithelial flap WITHOUT alcohol

triplets.head: Epi-LASEK
triplets.tail: Mechanical microkeratome + small amount of alcohol as fallback

triplets.head: TransPRK
triplets.tail: No-touch, all-laser — excimer removes epithelium then continues to stromal ablation in single step

triplets.head: TransPRK
triplets.tail: Dehydration, thermal effects, uniform epithelial assumption — abandoned

triplets.head: TransPRK
triplets.tail: Equivalent efficacy/safety; slightly better accuracy; faster healing; less pain; higher satisfaction; equivalent haze

triplets.head: Surface ablation (meta-analysis)
triplets.tail: No significant differences in effectiveness, predictability, or safety among PRK, LASEK, Epi-LASIK by 6 months (>1,400 eyes)

triplets.head: Surface ablation
triplets.tail: Less long-term dry eye (corneal nerves not transected)

triplets.head: Surface ablation
triplets.tail: Thin corneas, contact sports, anterior pathology, higher retreatment probability

triplets.head: WFO ablation
triplets.tail: Extra peripheral pulses maintain prolate shape; prevents new HOAs but doesn't treat pre-existing

triplets.head: WFG ablation
triplets.tail: Treats total ocular wavefront aberrations (measured by aberrometer)

triplets.head: TG ablation
triplets.tail: Treats corneal surface irregularities only (topographer data)

triplets.head: TG ablation
triplets.tail: Post-LASIK ectasia, decentered ablations, post-keratoplasty, post-RK

triplets.head: LASIK complications
triplets.tail: Flap issues (incomplete, buttonhole, striae, epithelial ingrowth, displacement), suction loss, OBL, dry eye, DLK, ectasia, glare/halos, regression

triplets.head: KLEx
triplets.tail: Femtosecond laser creates intrastromal refractive lenticule; extracted through small incision (2–5 mm); no excimer, no flap

triplets.head: KLEx
triplets.tail: Preserves greater corneal biomechanics; less nerve damage/dry eye

triplets.head: KLEx platforms (narrative review 2025)
triplets.tail: No clinically significant differences between platforms in final outcomes despite parameter variations

triplets.head: KLEx complications
triplets.tail: Suction loss, difficult lenticule extraction, cap/side-cut tears, black spots, OBL, dry eye (less than LASIK), over/undercorrection, regression, vertical coma induction

triplets.head: Alcon EX500 StreamLight
triplets.tail: EPI lists for 5 μm step PTK then WFO ablation

triplets.head: MEL 90
triplets.tail: Myopia up to −10 D, hyperopia up to +4 D, astigmatism 1–4 D

triplets.head: VisuMax 800
triplets.tail: Not yet FDA approved for flap creation in US

triplets.head: FEMTO LDV Z8
triplets.tail: CLEAR lenticule extraction + LASIK flaps + cataract

triplets.head: FEMTO LDV Z8
triplets.tail: Intraoperative OCT; liquid-optic interface; no suction ring

triplets.head: Moria One Use-Plus

triplets.head: Hansatome
triplets.tail: Upper hinge design; former industry standard

triplets.head: SKBM
triplets.tail: Discontinued — voluntary recall (loose glass applanation window)

triplets.head: EpiLift
triplets.tail: Applanator bar flattens tissue ahead of separator

triplets.head: Epi-K

triplets.head: Epi-K
triplets.tail: Shares Evolution 3E base with One Use-Plus and M2

triplets.head: Amadeus II Epikeratome
triplets.tail: Modified blade/holder creates epithelium-only flap (no stromal cutting)

triplets.head: iDESIGN Refractive Studio
triplets.tail: WFG LASIK (myopia up to −11 D/−5 D cyl; hyperopia up to +4 D/+2 D cyl; mixed astigmatism 1–5 D) and WFG PRK (myopia up to −8 D/−3 D cyl)

triplets.head: iDESIGN Refractive Studio
triplets.tail: Wavefront aberrometry, wavefront refraction, corneal topography (non-Placido), keratometry, scotopic/photopic pupillometry

triplets.head: OPD-Scan III
triplets.tail: Combined autorefractor + aberrometer + topographer + keratometer + pupillometer (5-in-1)

triplets.head: WaveLight Topolyzer VARIO
triplets.tail: Contoura Vision TG treatments on EX500

triplets.head: Orbscan IIz/III
triplets.tail: 40 slits, 9,000 data points in 1.5 s; 11 mm coverage

triplets.head: SCHWIND diagnostic systems
triplets.tail: Static cyclotorsion correction information for AMARIS/ATOS treatments

triplets.head: AS-OCT devices
triplets.tail: Zeiss Cirrus HD-OCT, Optovue Avanti RTVue XR, Heidelberg Spectralis, Tomey CASIA2, CSO MS-39

triplets.head: Pachymeter (ultrasound)
triplets.tail: 20–50 MHz probe, contact, gold standard for CCT

triplets.head: Pachymeter (optical)

triplets.head: Pupillometer

triplets.head: PRK

triplets.head: WFG PRK

triplets.head: Microkeratome LASIK
triplets.tail: Excimer laser + mechanical microkeratome + standard diagnostics

triplets.head: Femto-LASIK (WFO)
triplets.tail: Excimer laser (WFO-capable) + femtosecond laser for flaps + standard diagnostics

triplets.head: Femto-LASIK (WFG)
triplets.tail: Excimer laser + femtosecond laser + wavefront aberrometer + standard diagnostics

triplets.head: Femto-LASIK (TG/Contoura)
triplets.tail: Excimer laser (TG-capable) + femtosecond laser + high-resolution topographer + standard diagnostics

triplets.head: SMILE

triplets.head: CLEAR

triplets.head: Contact lens discontinuation
triplets.tail: Contact lenses cause corneal warpage — altered curvature, changed refraction, shifted pachymetry, irregular astigmatism — leading to inaccurate preoperative measurements

triplets.head: Corneal warpage
triplets.tail: Mechanical pressure + hypoxic stress → reversible corneal surface molding

triplets.head: Corneal warpage
triplets.tail: 2–12 weeks typical; up to 5 months in severe cases

triplets.head: Corneal warpage
triplets.tail: Two consecutive stable topographic maps ≥2 weeks apart

triplets.head: Contact lens discontinuation (AAO PPP 2024)
triplets.tail: Longer period + multiple visits to confirm refractive stability

triplets.tail: 2 weeks (FDA standard); 1–3 days may suffice for LASIK but not PRK

triplets.tail: ≥3 weeks (FDA); clinical rule: 4 weeks per decade of RGP wear

triplets.relation: refractive error recovery vs corneal thickness

triplets.head: Ortho-K discontinuation
triplets.tail: Younger age at initial wear → greater posterior steepening after discontinuation

triplets.head: Ortho-K discontinuation
triplets.tail: Longer wear may result in more pronounced steepening

triplets.head: Ortho-K discontinuation
triplets.tail: Refractive fluctuations ≤±0.50 D over consecutive weekly visits; curvature ≤±0.05 mm; elevation ≤±2 μm

triplets.head: Corneal stability confirmation principle
triplets.tail: No irregular astigmatism, no warpage pattern

triplets.head: Corneal stability confirmation principle
triplets.tail: Two consecutive stable measurement sets required before proceeding (minimum 2 visits)

triplets.head: Contact lens discontinuation (LASIK vs PRK)
triplets.tail: No clinically significant differences across SCL cessation periods of 1, 2, 3, 4–13, and >14 days

triplets.tail: After pre-op exam, contact lenses should NOT be worn again before surgery day
